headline: Endurance Technologies Limited: Acquisition
sum: Acquisition - Endurance Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about update on acquisition of additional stake in Stoeferle GmbH and Stoeferle Automotive GmbH by Endurance Overseas SpA, Italy ( EOSpA ), a wholly-owned subsidiary of…
detail: Acquisition - Endurance Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about update on acquisition of additional stake in Stoeferle GmbH and Stoeferle Automotive GmbH by Endurance Overseas SpA, Italy ( EOSpA ), a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company.
